versions.changelog:
auto-remotion v1.0.0

- Initial release with a complete workflow for generating promotional videos from existing screen recordings or demo videos.
- Covers all phases: environment setup, target/constraint clarification, manual or automated material selection, storyboard planning, structured specs, Remotion implementation, subtitles, Chinese voiceover (edge-tts), BGM selection, and final rendering.
- Provides detailed checklists, common issues, and decision frameworks for each stage.
- Supports both manual and agent (non-interactive) workflows, with templated commands and file structures.
- Includes integration and comparison notes for related skills (remotion-video-toolkit, remotion-best-practices).
- Outlines optional automation path—AI-assisted video segmentation via transcription and LLM processing.
